papers.title: Hydrogel to guide chondrogenesis versus osteogenesis of mesenchymal stem cells for fabrication of cartilaginous tissues.
papers.abstract: The ideal combination of hydrogel components for regeneration of cartilage and cartilaginous interfaces is a significant challenge because control over differentiation into multiple lineages is necessary. Stabilization of the phenotype of stem cell derived chondrocytes is needed to avoid undesired progression to terminal hypertrophy and tissue mineralization. A novel ternary blend hydrogel composed of methacrylated poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG), gelatin, and heparin (PGH) was designed to guide chondrogenesis by bone marrow derived mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and maintenance of their cartilaginous phenotype. The hydrogel material effects on chondrogenic and osteogenic differentiation by BMSCs were evaluated in comparison to methacrylated gelatin hydrogel (GEL), a conventional bioink used for both chondrogenic and osteogenic applications. PGH and GEL hydrogels were loaded with goat BMSCs and cultured in chondrogenic and osteogenic mediums in vitro over six weeks. The PGH showed no sign of mineral deposition in an osteogenic environment in vitro. To further evaluate material effects, the hydrogels were loaded with adult human BMSCs (hBMSCs) and transforming growth factor β-3 and grown in subcutaneous pockets in mice over eight weeks. Consistent with the in vitro results, the PGH had greater potential to induce chondrogenesis by BMSCs in vivo compared to the GEL as evidenced by elevated gene expression of chondrogenic markers, supporting its potential for stable cartilage engineering. The PGH also showed a greater percentage of GAG positive cells compared to the GEL. Unlike the GEL, the PGH hydrogel exhibited anti-osteogenic effects in vivo as evidenced by negative Von Kossa staining and suppressed gene expression of hypertrophic and osteogenic markers. By nature of their polymer composition alone, the PGH and GEL regulated BMSC differentiation down different osteochondral lineages. Thus, the PGH and GEL are promising hydrogels to regenerate stratified cartilaginous interfacial tissues in situ, such as the mandibular condyle surface, using undifferentiated BMSCs and a stratified scaffold design.

summary_zh.motivation: 寻找引导间充质干细胞向软骨分化的最佳水凝胶组合。
summary_zh.method: 设计三元共混水凝胶（PGH）并与明胶水凝胶对比，在体外和体内评估其诱导分化能力。
summary_zh.result: PGH水凝胶促进软骨分化并抑制成骨分化，适用于软骨界面组织再生。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外（BMSCs培养6周）和体内（小鼠皮下植入8周）实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To identify an optimal hydrogel combination that guides mesenchymal stem cell differentiation into cartilage while preventing hypertrophy and mineralization.
summary_en.method: A ternary blend hydrogel (PGH) of methacrylated PEG, gelatin, and heparin was designed and compared with gelatin hydrogel (GEL) in in vitro and in vivo differentiation assays.
summary_en.result: PGH hydrogel enhanced chondrogenesis and suppressed osteogenesis, showing potential for stratified cartilage tissue regeneration.
summary_en.validation: Validation included in vitro culture of goat BMSCs for six weeks and in vivo subcutaneous implantation in mice for eight weeks with histological and gene expression analyses.

papers.title: Pure copper components fabricated by cold spray (CS) and selective laser melting (SLM) technology
papers.abstract: To study effect of the different metal additive manufacturing techniques on microstructural evolution, phase constitution and the relationship between the microstructure and tensile behavior of pure Cu parts, components were manufactured by selective laser melting (SLM) technology and cold spraying (CS) technology, respectively. The microstructure of Cu parts was detected using an optical microscope (OM) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). The XRD spectrum revealed that only Cu phase is formed in the SLM Cu and CS Cu samples. The microstructure of the SLM Cu samples is constituted by the polycrystalline grains with substructures including the columnar dendrites and the equiaxed structures. As for the CS Cu samples, only the equiaxed grains were detected. In terms of the main physical properties, the averaged electrical conductivity of SLM Cu sample is 41% IACS, while that of CS Cu sample is 73% IACS. For the microhardness, the mean microhardness value of the CS Cu and the SLM Cu samples is 144.2 ± 4.3 HV0.05 and 83.6 ± 5.2 HV0.05, respectively. With regard to the statistic mechanical properties, the yield strength (YS) and ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of the SLM Cu part is approximately 185.8 ± 6.1 MPa and 242.2 ± 8.2 MPa, respectively.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM和冷喷涂两种增材制造技术对纯铜微观结构和力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM和冷喷涂分别制备纯铜样品，通过OM、SEM和XRD表征微观结构，测试电导率、显微硬度和拉伸性能
summary_zh.result: SLM铜样品具有柱状晶和等轴晶混合微观结构，冷喷涂铜样品仅等轴晶；冷喷涂铜的硬度更高但电导率相当
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试、硬度测试和电导率测量验证力学和物理性能

summary_en.motivation: To compare the effects of selective laser melting and cold spray additive manufacturing on the microstructure and mechanical properties of pure copper.
summary_en.method: Pure copper samples were fabricated by SLM and cold spray, characterized by OM, SEM, and XRD, and tested for electrical conductivity, microhardness, and tensile properties.
summary_en.result: SLM Cu showed mixed columnar and equiaxed grains while cold spray Cu had only equiaxed grains; cold spray Cu exhibited higher hardness but comparable strength to SLM Cu.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical and physical properties were validated via tensile testing, hardness measurements, and electrical conductivity tests.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热等静压对纳米颗粒增强SLM AlSi10Mg合金性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备纳米SiC增强AlSi10Mg粉末，进行SLM成形及热等静压处理，表征微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 热等静压显著降低孔隙率，提高致密度和硬度，改善耐磨和耐腐蚀性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EDS、XRD、硬度测试、摩擦磨损和电化学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of hot isostatic pressing on the microstructure and properties of nanoparticle-reinforced AlSi10Mg alloy produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: AlSi10Mg powder reinforced with SiC nanoparticles was processed by SLM followed by HIP, and characterized for porosity, microstructure, hardness, wear resistance, and corrosion behavior.
summary_en.result: HIP significantly reduced porosity, increased density and hardness, and improved both wear and corrosion resistance of the nanocomposite.
summary_en.validation: Validation included SEM, EDS, XRD, microhardness, pin-on-disc wear tests, and electrochemical corrosion tests.
